crossRefs.note: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai…
He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give…
The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
translations.bsb: So Jacob and everyone with him arrived in Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.
translations.kjv: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people
translations.asv: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan (the same is Beth-el), he and all the people that were with him.
